name: Blue Acquisition Corp. Unit
summary: Blue Acquisition Corp. functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), focused on identifying and merging with companies in high-growth sectors such as green energy, artificial intelligence (AI), cybersecurity, manufacturing, and data infrastructure. Each unit of BACCU is composed of one Class A ordinary share and an accompanying right, which will convert into one-tenth of an additional share after the completion of a business combination.
